# Lawsuit Center

> Attorney-built lawsuit research and case-review platform for mass tort, product liability, toxic exposure, and AI harm claims. Free, no-obligation case reviews and plain-English explanations of who may qualify. Lawsuit Center is the intake and referral practice of David Meldofsky, a California attorney, who refers each case review request to a participating law firm. The site provides no legal advice.

## Start here
- [Start a free case review](https://lawsuit.center/case-review): Submit basic information about a potential claim for review.
- [How case review works](https://lawsuit.center/how-case-review-works): What happens after you submit information, and how referral fees work.
- [Browse all lawsuits](https://lawsuit.center/lawsuits): Index of lawsuit categories covered on the site.
- [About Lawsuit Center](https://lawsuit.center/about): Who runs the platform and how it works.
- [David Meldofsky](https://lawsuit.center/david-meldofsky): Founder; California-licensed attorney.

## Free tools
- [Cancer exposure checker](https://lawsuit.center/cancer-exposure-checker): Maps a cancer diagnosis and exposure history to active case categories.
- [PFAS exposure checker](https://lawsuit.center/pfas-exposure-checker): Check your PFAS exposure history.
- [Processed food claim checker](https://lawsuit.center/processed-food-claim-checker): Type 2 diabetes or fatty liver diagnoses and ultra-processed food claims.
